kind: Acceptance criteria of the final held-out run of the Gemma speech evaluator (ADR-0025). Written and hashed BEFORE the evaluator was run on the held-out set. The numbers are the engineering targets already recorded in the gate (content/ai/thresholds.json, DT-245) and the reference of the experiment of 21 Oct 2026; none was changed after the held-out sentences existed.
evidence_class: AI-written and AI-reviewed synthetic held-out data. Not independent human validation, not real audio, not a headset result: the real Meta Quest and ASR end-to-end test (DC-09, Sannan) is a separate, later check.
rule: APPROVED only if every criterion passes at the point estimate. If a blocking criterion fails the result is BLOCKED. If only non-blocking criteria miss, the result is NOT APPROVED and the owner decides; the evaluator, prompt and criteria are not changed to chase the numbers, and the held-out set is not scored a second time.

criteria.name: critical physical completions credited from speech
legitimate credit recall (final engine score at least 0.5)
credited precision (credited acts that are right)
items of non-performed sentences (negated, planned, hypothetical, reported, another actor) that earn credit
critical-content items on which an ordinary objective earns credit
valid replies after the bounded retry
controlled partial-credit items inside their expected band (full >= 0.9, partial 0.1 to 0.9, wrong <= 0.25, irrelevant <= 0.1)
median response time per utterance (ms), the voice round-trip reference of C31 being 4 s
